items.title: Uniform simultaneous-preperiodic parameter bound for two marked points in the unicritical family z^d+t (Original Theorem1.1)
items.author: Hang Fu
items.work: Uniform unlikely intersections for unicritical polynomials

items.difficulty_reason: H2 的具体非例行义务是作者 §§3–4 中对 generalized Mandelbrot 参数集同时实现定量 Green 邻域上界和跨所有 place 的正能量下界，而不是最后两条分式的单调性。d=2 必须进一步定位三次预周期根以取得 1/|a| 尺度分离及 1/4 质量，d>2 需控制 d 个根的 1/|a|^(d−2) 尺度；非 Archimedean 端要通过两个 Newton polygon 顶点的递归识别证明根距离/简单性，并由盘树逐层根计数取得质量分配。随后 helpful/close/bounded places 的乘积公式与三种 Archimedean 区域的高度/紧性论证共同提供全局统一正间隙，最后结合显式正则化半径和 |S| 上界。这些当前构造与估计未被标准引用拿掉，明显超普通博士资格考试；保守按 H2，不因术语或期刊身份升 H3。

primary.label: Original Theorem1.1: uniform simultaneous-preperiodic parameter bound for each d>=2 (published PDF p.2)

proof_spans.label: Complete original §§3–5, all 30 current proof environments: quantitative upper bounds, complex and non-Archimedean lower bounds, height lower bound, positive energy gap, and full algebraic/complex Theorem1.1 proof (PDF pp.6–25)
Complete published DKY22 Lemma9.2 proof and next-page continuation, explicitly reused by Fu Theorem3.13 (print pp.403–404; physical pp.41–42)

contexts.label: Original Introduction: dynamics, preperiodicity and S_{a,b}; distinguishes common POINTS of two maps from common PARAMETERS of two marked points (PDF p.2)
Original proof strategy, supporting Theorems1.2/1.3/1.4, acknowledgments, and complete §2 notation/potential theory/equilibrium/adelic pairing prerequisites (PDF pp.2–6)
Published DKY22 pairing definition (9.2), complete §9.2 setup and Lemma9.2 statement; original numbered references retained with explicit map (print pp.402–403)
